paper_title: 1+12 Can Large Language Models Serve as Cross-Lingual Knowledge   Aggregators
caption: Statistics of the dataset in our experiments.
model_annotation: The pie chart presents a breakdown of the dataset used in an experiment, illustrating the distribution of different categories. There are six distinct slices representing the categories: “TriviaQA” (red, 25%, 997), “HalluQA” (purple, 5%, 185), “Chinese Domain” (green, 6%, 231), “HalluEval” (brown, 18%, 721), and “Chinese Domain” (gray, 6%, 231).  The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of area.  Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, and a legend is present, identifying the color associated with each category.
